briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple news reports and fact-checking organisations consistently report that the claim alleging Prime Minister Narendra Modi is providing three months of free mobile recharge to all Indians is false. Vishvas News debunked recurring iterations of this message in October 2023, January 2024, November 2024, January 2025, and August 2025, determining that circulating links are fraudulent schemes designed to steal user data. On 2025-11-25, BOOM reported that an accompanying viral clip of the Prime Minister announcing the offer was edited. On 2024-06-07, NDTV found no record of such a government scheme following the general election. In September 2026, ET Now, TV9 Hindi, and the Press Information Bureau's fact-checking unit reiterated that the Government of India operates no such program and warned that the viral links are phishing scams.
gaps_en: No official government notification or announcement exists supporting the claim.
